prompt: 我正在构建一个能读写数据库和发送邮件的企业 Agent。安全团队要求我做威胁建模和权限设计。这个 Agent 面向内部员工使用，但需要防止 Prompt Injection 和数据泄露。

assertions.description: Defines Agent-specific threat categories (not generic OWASP)
Defines Human-in-the-Loop gate patterns for high-risk operations
Includes specific Prompt Injection defense strategy (not just 'validate input')
Addresses data leakage prevention (PII detection, output filtering)
